items.name: a notched iron knife
items.description: The notches were cut at intervals someone calculated carefully. The iron holds something. It is not comfortable to carry.

items.name: Severance Blade
items.description: A narrow blade of dull grey metal, the edge ground at an angle that catches nothing. The bindings of the hollow yield before it.

items.name: Revelation Lens
items.description: A fragment of ground glass set in tarnished copper, sharpened to a point. What hides inside compressed bone does not hide from this.

items.name: Oil Lantern
items.description: A small iron vessel with a wick. Burns cleaner than a torch and longer. The light it produces is steadier and somehow less reassuring.

items.name: flint shard
items.description: A sharp-edged chip knocked from a larger piece of flint.
